results.name: actor_delete_swarm
results.evidence: Uses actor+0x28 as an index into the DAT_0088035c (stride 0x98) table; iterates the member count at offset+2 calling datum_delete() per member, then datum_delete()s the swarm struct itself and resets actor+0x28 to -1.
results.summary: If the actor has an associated swarm, deletes every swarm-member datum and the swarm datum itself, then clears the actor's swarm reference.

results.name: actor_cache_swarm_member_position
results.evidence: Looks up a unit via DAT_008603b0, tests its health field (+0xb4), takes its death-position pointer (+0x4d8) or -1, calls object_get_position(), and stores the value at offset+0x10 of a 0x40-byte-stride array (DAT_00880358) indexed by EAX — identical layout to the per-member loop inside FUN_004297a0.
results.summary: Given a swarm-slot index (EAX) and a unit index (ECX), records either that unit's death-position marker or -1 into the shared swarm-member position cache.

results.name: actor_is_ranged_burst_active
results.evidence: Checks actor+0x6a==3 (a state field) and actor+0x72 < actor+0x6e (current count vs. a limit) before returning a packed boolean.
results.summary: Returns whether the actor's combat sub-state (0x6a) is 3 and a per-burst counter (0x72) has not yet reached its configured length (0x6e); exact semantics of the state value are not confirmed.

results.name: actor_should_end_burst
results.evidence: Tests actor+0x6e>6 together with mode field(0x6c)==4 and a secondary counter(0xa8)>0, using the same burst-length field referenced by FUN_00428180.
results.summary: Boolean check combining the actor's burst-length field (0x6e), a mode value (0x6c), and a secondary counter (0xa8); precise behavioral meaning is not confirmed from the code alone.

results.name: actor_get_aim_target_position
results.evidence: Chooses between copying a cached aim/facing-derived position (fields 0x180-0x188, the same fields populated from unit-orientation data in FUN_004297a0) or a secondary position (0x63c-0x644) into the caller's output pointer, gated by flags at 0x6a0/0x60c and a mode-table lookup on DAT_00655258.
results.summary: Writes one of two cached 3-float positions into the output vector supplied via EDX, selected by internal actor state flags; returns whether a position was produced.

results.name: actor_is_vehicle_timer_expired
results.evidence: Only proceeds when mode field(0x6c)==10 (vehicle mode, matching the same field checked as 10 in FUN_00429430) and sub-state(0xa0)==3 with flag(0xa7) set; compares actor+0xac+0x1e against a global time value at DAT_006f1d6c+0xc.
results.summary: For an actor in vehicle mode with a particular sub-state, checks whether a per-actor tick counter has exceeded a global time threshold.

results.name: actor_get_threat_weapon_object_index
results.evidence: When the actor has a tracked hostile unit (flags 0x161/0x158) it resolves that unit's active-weapon slot (unit+0x2f2 index into unit+0x2f8 array); otherwise, given a valid unit (actor+0x18) whose owning player flag bit 0x40 (at (+0x14) is clear, it falls back to unit_get_weapon_object_index().
results.summary: Returns the weapon object index of the actor's currently perceived hostile unit, or falls back to the actor's own unit's weapon.

results.name: actor_has_active_weapon_threat
results.evidence: Calls FUN_004282c0 (threat-weapon lookup) and forces the result to false when the actor's referenced unit (actor+0x18) has bit 0 of byte+0x107 set.
results.summary: Reports whether a weapon threat exists via FUN_004282c0, suppressing the result when the associated unit carries a particular status flag (byte+0x107 bit 0).

results.name: actor_get_squad_status_field
results.evidence: Resolves the actor's squad through actor+0x270 into the 0x138-stride squad table (DAT_008802c0) and returns the dword at squad+0x18, or -1 if the actor has no squad.
results.summary: Getter that returns a per-squad dword field (offset 0x18) for the squad referenced by the actor's squad index, or -1 when it has none; exact meaning of the field is unconfirmed.

results.name: actor_report_squad_name
results.evidence: Performs the same squad lookup as FUN_004283d0 (actor+0x270 into DAT_008802c0, field+0x18) and forwards the retrieved value together with param_1 into FUN_0041f7d0.
results.summary: Looks up a field on the actor's squad and forwards it, together with a caller-supplied value, to FUN_0041f7d0; likely used for a squad-name-based callout, but not confirmed.

results.name: actor_replace_object_reference
results.evidence: Compares many actor sub-fields (0x270,0x610,0x6b4,0x2f4,0x30c,0x340,0x3ac,0x1d0,0x1e8,0x470,0x550,0x570,0x580) and each swarm member's field+0x14 against an old id (unaff_EDI), rewriting matches to a new id (unaff_ESI) and clearing dependent counters, then invokes the actor-type callback table DAT_00655274.
results.summary: Scans an actor's numerous cached object-index fields (and its swarm members') for a stale object reference and replaces it with a new one, clearing dependent state and notifying the per-type callback.

results.name: actor_clear_target_on_mode_change
results.evidence: Resets field 0x3b8 to 0xffff and, when mode(0x46c) is 3 or 4, also clears 0x46c and sets 0x480 to -1, then dispatches to the actor-type callback table DAT_00655278.
results.summary: Clears a cached target field and, if the actor is in mode 3 or 4, resets its secondary target sub-state, then invokes the per-type callback table.

results.name: actor_invalidate_target_caches
results.evidence: Resets several target/threat-related fields (0x144,0x148,0x164,0x324,0x410,0x47c,0x494) plus, for each swarm member, field+0x10, then dispatches to the actor-type callback table DAT_0065527c.
results.summary: Invalidates the actor's cached target/threat references (including its swarm members') and invokes the per-type callback table.

results.name: actor_compute_look_direction
results.evidence: Chooses between a delta-to-cached-target vector (0x488/0x48c/0x490 minus 300/0x130/0x134) and a fixed direction (0x518-0x520) based on flags at 0x504/0x4a8, then calls vector3d_normalize_with_length().
results.summary: Computes and normalizes a direction vector for the actor to look toward, choosing between a fixed field and the delta to a cached target position; returns whether the result was non-degenerate.

results.name: actor_reset_squad_field_and_notify
results.evidence: Resolves a squad slot via FUN_0043eb30(param_1,1,1), clears field+0x6c, sets flag+0x74=1, and adds param_2 to float field+0x70 for that squad and, if present, a linked squad at +0xc, then calls FUN_00422270(param_1).
results.summary: Applies a time delta to a squad's timer/flags (and a linked squad's, if any) before invoking further per-actor cleanup via FUN_00422270.

results.name: actor_delete_or_release_unit
results.evidence: For a non-swarm actor (byte+6==0), chooses between object_delete_4f9030/FUN_004f59d0 (dead path) or FUN_004f5bd0 (alive path) based on a flag returned from FUN_00428ab0; for a swarm actor, walks the linked member list (+0x24), deleting or releasing each based on its unit type (+4 field).
results.summary: Deletes or detaches the game object(s) tied to an actor (or each of its swarm members), branching on whether the target is dead and on its unit type.

results.name: actor_set_object_flag_and_shutdown
results.evidence: Sets bit 0x20 or 0x40 on the referenced object's byte+0x106 for a single actor, or for each swarm member, and unless param_2 suppresses it, tears the actor(s) down via FUN_00427bc0/FUN_00427c90 then FUN_00427e60/FUN_00437940.
results.summary: Marks the actor's (or each swarm member's) object with a status bit and, unless suppressed, deactivates and frees the actor(s) via the shared teardown helpers.

results.name: actor_attempt_grenade_throw
results.evidence: Computes a difficulty-scaled probability from a per-player field (+0x94), scales it up under squad/vehicle conditions, rolls random_real() against it, and on success calls FUN_006391b4()/FUN_00563b20(...,0x800) to pick and start a grenade throw; also runs the same DAT_00719cd0 LCG-based grenade-count adjustment seen in actor_died_unit_grenade_count_mod.
results.summary: Per-tick decision that rolls a difficulty-scaled random chance for a suitable actor (valid weapon, isolated target) to throw a grenade, then updates related grenade-count/timing housekeeping.

results.name: actor_died_unit_grenade_count_mod
results.evidence: Clears a per-encounter counter (unaff_EBX+0x31e=0) and, for a valid unit, randomly adjusts grenade-count/timing fields (0x1d8-0x1e2) using the DAT_00719cd0 LCG via FUN_004c58c0/FUN_004c5820 — duplicated from the tail of FUN_00428ab0's grenade-decision code, then finishes with FUN_00427e60/FUN_00437940.
results.summary: Cleanup path invoked when the actor whose grenade decision was being processed has become invalid, randomizing its grenade-count/timing fields before releasing it from its encounter.

results.name: actor_release_from_encounter
results.evidence: Calls FUN_00427c90(param_1) then, only if actor field+0x1e==0 (no remaining references), forwards actor+0x34 (an encounter/zone index) to FUN_00427e60(1)/FUN_00437940.
results.summary: Reduces an actor use-count and, once it reaches zero, notifies the actor's associated encounter via the shared release helpers.

results.name: ai_release_actors_and_swarms
results.evidence: Toggles fields on the AI globals struct (DAT_00880354) and iterates FUN_00436a70() over every live actor, immediately releasing swarm-flagged actors (short at +0x6a>0) via FUN_00429160, or deleting the rest via FUN_004288e0 when a status byte(+0xb) is set.
results.summary: Iterates every active actor as part of AI global cleanup, tearing down/resetting swarm actors and deleting the remainder.

results.name: actor_reset_perception_state
results.evidence: Zeroes a 64-byte local scratch block, seeds part of it from a fixed 3-float constant (PTR_DAT_00696714) and constant flags, calls FUN_00569720() (also used alongside object_get_position elsewhere), copies several unit fields (0x23c,0x240,0x244,0x260,0x264,0x268), then calls FUN_005639f0(-1) and FUN_00569bf0().
results.summary: Resets a per-actor perception/aim scratch structure, seeding it from the current unit's orientation fields before clearing related lookahead state.

results.name: actor_reset_perception_dispatch
results.evidence: For a solo actor (byte+6==0) calls FUN_00428f40 once and sets flag+7=1; for a swarm actor it loops the swarm's member count (DAT_0088035c[actor+0x28]+2) calling FUN_00428f40 once per member.
results.summary: Runs the per-unit perception reset either once for a solo actor or once per swarm member, then marks the actor as initialized.

results.name: ai_reset_all_actors_perception
results.evidence: Loops FUN_00436a70() over every live actor, calling FUN_00429000 on each.
results.summary: Iterates all active actors and re-runs their perception-reset dispatcher.

results.name: actor_notify_mode_change
results.evidence: Calls FUN_00428650 (mode 3/4 target clear) then, based on flag byte+9, either FUN_00436620(0) or FUN_00436990, and based on a register value (unaff_EBX==-1) calls FUN_00436940 or FUN_00436770.
results.summary: Runs a sequence of squad/encounter notification callbacks after clearing an actor's target state, branching on a couple of actor/context flags.

results.name: actor_update_activation_state
results.evidence: Gates on FUN_00429270's return value; on success runs FUN_00429430/FUN_004297a0/FUN_0041abd0/FUN_004203a0/FUN_004213b0, zeroes a 132-byte block at actor+1000, resets three shorts to -1, calls FUN_00429ee0, invokes the actor-type callback table DAT_00655264, and (when not already active per byte+0x13) either continues via FUN_004266a0 or runs a full activation chain including actor_invoke_type_handler and actor_schedule_grenade_throw.
results.summary: Per-tick actor combat-state update: validates via FUN_00429270 then refreshes threat/perception/orientation sub-state and either continues an in-progress transition or performs a full combat activation sequence, including scheduling a grenade throw.

results.name: actor_update_squad_link_state
results.evidence: Returns after deleting the actor (FUN_004288e0) when it is a swarm member with no swarm; otherwise decrements timers at 0x78/0x92, checks the linked squad's disabled flag and the unit's own flags, and calls FUN_00427860 immediately or after a retry counter (+0x14) exceeds 0x3b.
results.summary: Per-tick housekeeping for an actor's link to its squad/encounter — expiring timers, checking removed/disabled state, and forcing a reassignment once the link becomes stale for too long.

results.name: actor_update_boredom_counter
results.evidence: Increments actor+0x4a by 1, or by 3 when mode(0x6c)==10 with sub-state(0xa0) in {2,3,4,5} (vehicle boarding states), compares it against a global threshold at DAT_00880354+4, resets it and flags DAT_00880354+3 once past a cap, and otherwise tracks a running maximum at DAT_00880354+6.
results.summary: Advances a per-actor idle/boredom counter (faster while boarding a vehicle) and, once it exceeds a global cap, resets it and raises a global flag, while also tracking the observed maximum.

results.name: actor_snapshot_orientation
results.evidence: Copies actor position/orientation fields (0x174-0x194) into a secondary cache block (0x6fc-0x71c), zeroes 0x6d0/0x720, copies a fixed 3-float constant (PTR_DAT_00696714) into 0x6e0-0x6e8, and resets 0x6ec to -1.
results.summary: Snapshots the actor's current orientation/position fields into a secondary cache block and resets an associated status word and target field, used when starting a new activation cycle.

results.name: actor_update_target_lead_position
results.evidence: When no cached intercept exists (actor+0x164==-1), seeds it from the actor's own position (fields 300/0x130/0x134), then, lacking a tracked threat, computes a lead position via object_try_and_get(1)+FUN_0055ab30, or via FUN_00571de0 when tracking a vehicle-type threat (0x15e in [2,3]).
results.summary: Computes and caches a predicted intercept/lead position for the actor's target, choosing a generic or vehicle-specific calculation depending on the tracked threat's type.

results.name: actor_get_accuracy_scale
results.evidence: Returns a float10 accuracy multiplier defaulting to 0.5, replaced by a per-player difficulty value at object+900 when tracking a unit, overridden to a fixed field (0xf4) for mode 11, forced to 0.7 for mode 9, and clamped to a minimum of 0.2.
results.summary: Computes the actor's effective accuracy scale for the current tick, based on difficulty settings and special-cased combat modes 9 and 11.

results.name: actor_capture_facing_and_root_position
results.evidence: Copies unit position fields (0x74-0x7c) and a computed vector from FUN_004f6080 into the output struct, then walks the unit's parent chain (+0x11c) to the root object and copies its fields at 0x98/0x9c.
results.summary: Fills a caller-provided struct with the actor's unit position/orientation plus a pair of fields from the root object at the top of its parent chain.

results.name: actor_refresh_combat_context
results.evidence: For swarm-follower actors, recomputes the swarm centroid from member positions (DAT_0088035c/DAT_00880358); for the leader/solo actor it re-derives target/threat/vehicle state from the controlling player-control structure (DAT_0087bc14 table, fields 0xc9/0xca/0xcd), scans a linked-object list (+0x118) against a visibility grid (DAT_006b0b84), and recomputes facing/right-vector fields (0x174-0x1c4).
results.summary: Full per-tick recomputation of an actor's (or swarm's) combat context: aggregated swarm position, current target/threat/vehicle relationship with its controlling player, nearby perceived threats, and derived aim/orientation vectors.

results.name: actor_run_mode_transition_loop
results.evidence: Repeatedly invokes the actor-type's mode handler via PTR_PTR_006853b8[mode]+0x14 and clears a 100-dword block (+0x2ec), looping up to 10 times while a per-type callback DAT_00655260 keeps signalling a further transition (flag+0x70), finally forcing actor_set_mode(param_1,0,0) if the loop is exhausted.
results.summary: Drives an actor's mode-transition state machine, invoking the per-mode handler and per-type transition callback until settled, forcing mode 0 if it never settles within 10 iterations.

results.name: ai_broadcast_communication_to_actors
results.evidence: Optionally builds a local communication-event record (guarded by DAT_00880354+1), then iterates FUN_00436a70() over actors whose mode field(+0x6e)<7, testing relevance via FUN_0041c1e0/FUN_0041c030 and dispatching to FUN_00422780/FUN_00422930/FUN_00422c00 based on param_2 (0,1,2).
results.summary: Broadcasts an AI communication/order event (selected by event_type) to every eligible active actor, gating delivery per-actor through a relevance test.

results.name: ai_alert_actors_in_grenade_radius
results.evidence: Builds a bitmask of nearby pathfinding nodes within roughly 40 units (using a per-node distance table at DAT_00746f9c+0x220) around the target object's node, then for every active actor whose cached firing-position node (+0x148) falls inside that bitmask, runs relevance checks (FUN_0041c1e0/FUN_0041c030) and reacts via FUN_0042a3a0.
results.summary: Given a grenade/threat's originating object, marks nearby pathfinding nodes within a radius and triggers a squad reaction (FUN_0042a3a0) for every actor whose firing position sits inside that radius.

results.name: actor_squad_react_to_grenade
results.evidence: Resolves the squad (DAT_008802c0[param_1]) and the throwing unit's cowardice flag (DAT_008802c8[.]+0x41), records the grenade's timer into squad+0x66/0x68, then switches on grenade type (in_AX) between dive/avoid (FUN_00422550), throw-back (FUN_00422ec0/FUN_00427860), retreat (FUN_00427860/FUN_00423220), or panic (FUN_0041b980).
results.summary: Reacts a squad to an incoming grenade of a given type by triggering the corresponding avoidance behavior (dive, throw back, retreat, or panic), unless the squad is already handling one.

results.name: actor_squad_dispatch_order
results.evidence: Switches on an order record's type field (in_ECX+0x14, values 2/3/4), calling FUN_004221f0, or FUN_0041f7d0 guarded by datum_get on the squad's field at DAT_008802c0[.]+0x1c, or FUN_004233d0.
results.summary: Dispatches one of several squad-order handlers based on an order record's type field.

results.name: actor_mark_dirty_flag
results.evidence: Unconditionally ORs bit 0x2 into the actor's status-flags field at +0x6d0.
results.summary: Sets a single status-flag bit (0x2) on the actor's general flags field (+0x6d0); the precise meaning of the bit is not confirmed.

results.name: actor_set_override_target
results.evidence: Sets or clears bit 0x800 of actor+0x6d0 depending on param_1, and always stores param_2 into +0x720 — the same field reset to 0 by actor_snapshot_orientation.
results.summary: Enables or disables an override-target flag (bit 0x800 of the actor's flags word) and records the supplied value into the override-target field.

results.name: actor_apply_pending_look_and_damage
results.evidence: Gated on the tracked unit lacking a vehicle-seat reference (+0x218) or a global debug flag (DAT_0087a478+0x11); releases a held item (FUN_00569bf0) if flag+7 is set, clears a look override (FUN_005639f0(-1)), applies a pending look direction (FUN_00569530 with fields +0x6ec/+0x6f0), and applies a pending value pair (+0x6d4/+0x6d8) into the unit's fields 0x210/0x214.
results.summary: Applies queued look-direction and state changes to the actor's unit once it is no longer held in a vehicle seat (or when a global debug flag forces it).

results.name: ai_initialize_for_new_map
results.evidence: Carves the AI globals block (size 0x8dc) out of a bump allocator, feeds its size into crc32_update (map checksum accumulation), zeroes it, then calls actors_initialize, allocates a table via FUN_005380d0, and calls encounters_initialize/ai_communication_initialize/FUN_0041a2d0.
results.summary: Allocates and zero-initializes the main AI globals structure for a newly loaded map, then initializes the actor, squad, encounter, and communication subsystems.

results.name: ai_reset_for_new_map
results.evidence: Re-zeroes the AI globals block and reinitializes its default flags, then calls data_delete_all on the actor/swarm/position-cache/squad datum arrays (DAT_00880360/0088035c/00880358/008802c0), followed by FUN_00435cb0/FUN_0042d230 and clearing a name-table region.
results.summary: Clears all AI data arrays (actors, swarms, position cache, squads) and resets the AI globals structure to its default state, e.g. when restarting or reloading a map.

results.name: ai_globals_tick
results.evidence: Top-level gate on DAT_00880354[1] (an 'AI active' flag) that runs FUN_0042bf90, then dispatches to either the main update chain (FUN_00430a70, FUN_00435e00, actor teardown via FUN_00428ea0) or the reset chain (FUN_00429080) based on globals flags at offsets 0 and 2.
results.summary: Top-level AI subsystem tick dispatcher: runs the main per-frame update pipeline or the reset/perception-reinitialize pipeline based on global AI state flags.

results.name: ai_difficulty_get_scalar
results.evidence: Switches on a request code (in_AX, 1..4), returning fixed difficulty-table lookups via FUN_0046fe10(0x1c/0x1d/0x1e) or fixed boolean pairs for cases 3 and 4.
results.summary: Returns a difficulty-tuning scalar or a boolean pair selected by a small enumerated request code, backed by FUN_0046fe10's difficulty table.

results.name: ai_zone_bias_random_step
results.evidence: Reads a per-zone bias value from a table indexed via DAT_008802c8/DAT_008802cc, nudges it by a signed random step derived from the DAT_00719cd0 LCG compared against a threshold built from a global rate field at DAT_00880354+0xc.
results.summary: Randomly nudges a per-zone/index bias value up or down, bounded by a floor derived from a global rate, used to slowly drift an AI behavior parameter over time.

results.name: actor_apply_zone_hearing_scale
results.evidence: Scales the caller-supplied float (EDX) by a per-actor field (+0x69c) when a zone flag byte (param_1+4, bit 3) is set, or by a fixed 0.3 when actor field +0x1ca is set.
results.summary: Applies a per-actor perception-scaling factor to a caller-provided float (such as a hearing or awareness range), based on a zone flag and an actor state byte.

results.name: ai_release_actors_by_criteria
results.evidence: When AI is active and no filter unit is given (in_EAX==-1), releases every actor via FUN_004288e0; otherwise walks the linked actor list from FUN_004369f0, filtering by squad/encounter fields (+0x3c,+0x3a) before releasing matches.
results.summary: Releases all active actors, or only those matching a given encounter/squad filter, as part of AI cleanup.

results.name: ai_release_inactive_swarms
results.evidence: String '%d swarm units' formatted via sprintf; iterates all actors, releasing (FUN_004288e0) each currently-inactive swarm actor (byte+6!=0, byte+8==0, field+0xc!=-1) while accumulating its unit count (+0x1e).
results.summary: Iterates all actors, releasing each currently-inactive swarm and accumulating its total unit count into a '%d swarm units' status string, reporting whether any were released.

results.name: ai_squad_priority_compare
results.evidence: Classic qsort comparator taking two byte-pointer records and comparing the dword at +8 (descending) then the leading byte (ascending); passed as the comparator argument to _qsort in FUN_0042acd0.
results.summary: qsort comparator that orders candidate entries by a priority dword (descending) with a tie-break on a leading byte (ascending).

results.name: ai_build_priority_target_list
results.evidence: Builds a list from active actors (walking a linked list rooted at DAT_00880354+8), then appends encounter squads discovered via data_iterator_next filtering on flag+0xd/count+0x2a/valid+0x10, capping at 256 entries, and finally sorts it with _qsort using ai_squad_priority_compare.
results.summary: Assembles and sorts a combined list of active actor-groups and eligible encounters, used to prioritize which AI groups to process or release.

results.name: ai_release_inactive_encounters
results.evidence: Strings 'encounter %s (%d units)' and 'encounterless-actor %s'; consumes the list built by ai_build_priority_target_list one entry per call, releasing either a whole encounter (via ai_release_actors_by_criteria(-1)) or a lone actor (via FUN_004288e0), formatting the appropriate status string.
results.summary: Iterates a prioritized encounter/actor list one entry per call, releasing each entry (a whole encounter or a lone actor) and formatting a status string describing what was released.

results.name: actor_init_grenade_avoid_timer
results.evidence: Captures a random jitter via FUN_0055a2e0 and stores it, param_1, a register-supplied id (unaff_EDI), and a fixed 0.15-second deadline into a caller-referenced record, matching the record consumed by the grenade-avoidance flow in actor_gather_nearby_grenade_targets and actor_squad_react_to_grenade.
results.summary: Initializes a per-actor grenade-avoidance timer/record with a small random jitter and a fixed 0.15-second window.

results.name: actor_gather_nearby_grenade_targets
results.evidence: Walks the acting unit's squad-mates via a linked list rooted at DAT_008802c8[.]+0x14, then all squads bucketed under the actor's location (DAT_00880360+0x50), selecting up to param_2 eligible candidates (excluding the thrower and disabled/assigned squads) and initializing an avoidance record for each via actor_init_grenade_avoid_timer.
results.summary: Collects up to a requested number of nearby friendly actors/squads (excluding the source) and starts a grenade-avoidance timer for each, returning how many were selected.

results.name: actor_grenade_path_blocked
results.evidence: Iterates the candidate list built by actor_gather_nearby_grenade_targets, testing each with either segment3d_within_radius_of_segment or ray_intersects_sphere_test depending on a per-entry flag, excluding the thrower (param_1).
results.summary: Checks whether a grenade's trajectory or landing radius intersects any nearby gathered actor other than the thrower, returning the blocking actor's index if so.

results.name: actor_can_reach_or_see_target
results.evidence: Gates on FUN_0053eb60 (zone connectivity), builds a pathfinding/LOS query flag word from param_2/param_4, calls FUN_00505880 for a path/LOS result, validates candidate points via FUN_00401a20 for melee-vs-ranged cases (param_1 1 or 2), and otherwise falls back to a distance/speed check against local_60.
results.summary: Determines whether and how an actor can reach or engage a target, combining a pathfinding/LOS query with distance and speed checks, returning a graded result code from clear (0) to unreachable (4).

results.name: actor_trajectory_is_clear
results.evidence: Simulates a parabolic trajectory (param_2 as a gravity-like acceleration) in 6-unit steps up to param_1, testing each segment with FUN_00505880 (LOS/path) and against the actor_gather_nearby_grenade_targets candidate list via segment3d_within_radius_of_segment.
results.summary: Steps a projected parabolic trajectory forward in short segments, checking line-of-sight and proximity to nearby actors along each segment to determine whether the whole path stays clear.

results.name: actor_flag_vehicle_boarding_target
results.evidence: Only proceeds if the referenced object has a valid vehicle-seat reference (+0x218), then calls FUN_0045bd50 and, if it fails, optionally sets actor byte +0x2ed=1.
results.summary: Checks whether an actor's vehicle target is currently available and, if not, optionally flags the actor to pursue boarding it.

results.name: actor_update_vehicle_seat_assignment
results.evidence: Resolves a vehicle object via object_try_and_get(3) and its assigned seats (+0x328,+0x324) to determine a desired seat id; calls FUN_0045bd50 when the actor's current seat (unaff_EDI) differs, then runs FUN_0042d340(0)/FUN_00430d30/FUN_00435f90.
results.summary: Reassigns an actor's vehicle seat when it differs from the vehicle's currently assigned seat, then runs follow-up squad/vehicle bookkeeping.

results.name: ai_notify_actors_of_encounter_state_change
results.evidence: Iterates all actors matching either of two zone ids (param_1/param_2, tested against field+0x3e), and for each squad located in that actor's location bucket, updates squad status flags (+0x60,+0x61,+0x62) and a derived float (+0x50) via FUN_0041fc60/FUN_0041fd50 according to param_3/param_4.
results.prototype: void __cdecl ai_notify_actors_of_encounter_state_change(short zone_a, short zone_b, char status, char force_update)
results.summary: Updates squad status flags and a derived timing value for every squad tied to actors in either of two specified zones, used when an encounter/zone's active state changes.
